summary: Frontend-only testing of AetherCore redesign. Verified custom cursor, /precos pricing overhaul, /sustentabilidade card system, /casos-de-uso comparativo, general navigation and ZIP download. All requested features are working. Only cosmetic console warnings (React fetchpriority attribute case, leak-stats fallback fetch) present — non-blocking.
action_items: OPTIONAL/cosmetic: React warning 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' appears on every route — replace `fetchpriority` with `fetchPriority` in JSX (or use lowercase in inline HTML) to silence.

OPTIONAL/cosmetic: Home page 'Failed to fetch live leak stats' warning — fetch is failing (likely CORS/blocked network to external API); fallback is used correctly so UI is intact, but consider silencing or moving to server proxy.
critical_code_review_comments: Cursor implementation is correct: pointer-events:none on both dot & ring, z-index 9999/10000, html.aether-cursor-active toggles native cursor:none. Hover class 'aether-hovering' verified triggered on link.
Pricing toggle logic correct: monthly R$49/R$149, annual R$470/R$1430 with /ano suffix; no visual clipping detected (scrollWidth==clientWidth on Go card).

.aether-card:hover CSS confirmed present (border-color rgba(255,59,0,0.5), translateY(-6px), icon fill orange). Verified visually on sust-card-0 and sust-card-2 (card-1 was a test-side mouse teleport flake, not a code bug).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All redesigned features verified. Notes: (1) Playwright's page.mouse.move does not visibly update the spring-animated cursor position in headless (spring physics + short observation window); however the mousemove listener IS receiving events (proven by aether-hovering class being applied on link hover). (2) Hover state may be lost between two evaluate calls if the cursor drifts — hover each card immediately before reading the border color, and move the mouse to (10,10) first to reset state between cards. (3) Score cards on /casos-de-uso ('6/6 vulnerabilidades', '2 críticos', '6/6 categorias em conformidade') only render after scrolling below the hero — scroll gradually in 500-600px steps to trigger Framer whileInView animations. (4) Lenis smooth-scroll is active — use window.scrollTo(0,y) or element.scrollIntoView plus ~1500ms wait. (5) Backend explicitly excluded from scope.

precos.marquee_animating: transform changed from matrix(1,0,0,1,-537,0) to matrix(1,0,0,1,-767,0) in 1.2s
precos.annual_pricing: Go R$470/ano, Enterprise R$1430/ano — no clipping (scrollW==clientW)

casos_de_uso.score_cards_visible: 6/6 vulnerabilidades, 2 críticos violações LGPD, 6/6 categorias em conformidade
